description.short_caption: Giemsa stain of skin biopsy showing intracellular and extracellular organisms.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Giemsa-stained preparation of a skin biopsy. The stain highlights intracellular and extracellular round structures, consistent with organisms. The purple-stained structures are prominent and appear to have a central nucleus-like feature. The background shows scattered cellular debris and faint staining. The magnification suggests a microscopic view suitable for identifying pathogens.

description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion with central crusting on the upper arm.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a close-up view of the upper arm with a single, round lesion. The lesion is erythematous with a central area of crusting or scabbing. Surrounding the lesion, there is mild redness extending into the adjacent skin. The lesion appears to be well-demarcated and slightly raised.
